## Findings

- [ ] **[BLOCK][Git] Working tree is dirty — 6 modified + 2 untracked paths**
  - **Status quo:** Modified: AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/agent-integration.md, gui/Sources/Info.plist, gui/project.yml, release-notes.md (deleted). Untracked: assets/, gui/Sources/Assets.xcassets/
  - **Likely cause:** GUI branding session (app name, icon assets) + v0.15.0 doc follow-ups were left uncommitted.
  - **Proposed solution:** Commit these changes as a pre-release docs/branding commit before running /07-gh-release. The release-notes.md deletion is consistent with the repo's per-release notes pattern.
  - **Handoff:** Review changes with `git diff`, then `git add -A && git commit -m "docs: update README/AGENTS for evidence spans; gui: app branding and icon assets"`

- [ ] **[BLOCK][Coverage] Regression -0.4% vs last release baseline**
  - **Status quo:** `.github/coverage/2026-07-23T08:45:00Z.md` — overall 68.2%, baseline 68.6% → 68.2% (delta -0.4%)
  - **Likely cause:** Coverage measured at commit 246396f (before the latest test-coverage PRs merged). The regression may already be resolved by #384/#385 (importer/cmd/working-memory coverage tests).
  - **Proposed solution:** Re-run coverage measurement on current HEAD to verify the regression is resolved. If still negative, hand off to test-coverage workflow.
  - **Handoff:** `/test-coverage --baseline-ref v0.15.0`, then if still regressed: `/02-gh-plan --from-coverage <path>` → `/03-gh-go`

- [ ] **[BLOCK][Distribution] Notarization auth method mismatch — will 401 on first GUI release**
  - **Status quo:** `release.yml` gui-release job (lines 205-209) uses `--apple-id`/`--team-id`/`--password` flow. The `NOTARY_API_KEY` secret contains an API-key (p8) value, not an app-specific password. The `NOTARY_API_KEY_ID` secret contains the key ID, not an Apple-ID email.
  - **Likely cause:** The gui-release job was copied from the CLI notarization step (lines 81-85), which uses the same incorrect pattern. Both jobs will fail with 401 Invalid credentials.
  - **Proposed solution:** Switch both notarization steps to API-key auth: decode `NOTARY_API_KEY` (base64 p8) to a temp file, use `xcrun notarytool submit -k <file> -d <NOTARY_API_KEY_ID> -i <NOTARY_API_ISSUER>`. The `NOTARY_API_ISSUER` secret holds the issuer UUID.
  - **Handoff:** Fix release.yml notarization auth before tagging; see 07-gh-release → references/release-credentials.md and symaira-gui-release skill "Method A — API key (p8, preferred for CI)"

- [ ] **[WARN][Version] GUI app version hardcoded to "1.0.0" — inconsistent with tool version**
  - **Status quo:** `gui/project.yml` line 28: `CFBundleShortVersionString: "1.0.0"`; `gui/Sources/Info.plist` same. The release workflow patches this at build time via `plutil -replace`, so the DMG will carry the correct tag version.
  - **Likely cause:** GUI was scaffolded with a placeholder version.
  - **Proposed solution:** No immediate action needed — the CI override works. Consider aligning the placeholder to the tool version in a future cleanup to avoid confusion.

- [ ] **[WARN][Coverage] Absolute coverage 68.2% below 80% default gate**
  - **Status quo:** 68.2% overall; several packages below 60% (cmd 46.5%, importer/aider 3.8%, importer/calendar 15.7%)
  - **Likely cause:** Importer packages and cmd entrypoints have low test coverage by design (thin wrappers); no repo hard gate enforces 80%.
  - **Proposed solution:** Track coverage improvement in the normal iteration cycle; no release blocker.
